Ideal for sorting machinery, the SX10 is so quick to respond that it can signal ON at 0.45 ms and OFF at 0.4 ms. Available in several flow and frequency options, the SX10 offers versatility and is compact in design with easy installation and removal thanks to a quick disconnect mounting option. Its flexibility means the SX10 is ideal for colour sorting machinery, plastics recycling and waste separation and gluing, dosing, packaging and vacuum applications.

Ideal for sorting machinery, the SX10 is so quick to respond that it can signal ON at 0.45 ms and OFF at 0.4 ms. It can also support greater productivity with frequency rates of up to 1,200 cycles per second and cost savings due to its long life capability of more than 5,000 million cycles and low power consumption of just 4 W. Available in several flow and frequency options, the SX10 offers versatility and is compact in design with easy installation and removal thanks to a quick disconnect mounting option. Its flexibility means the SX10 is ideal for colour sorting machinery, plastics recycling and waste separation and gluing, dosing, packaging and vacuum applications.
